name: boulevard
description: Boulevard, a verified SMU dating app. Rust on Cloudflare Workers; wrangler is pinned here for local dev and deploys.

scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply boulevard --local --config crates/boulevard-worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply boulevard --remote --config crates/boulevard-worker/wrangler.jsonc
